point_forecasts: Frozen prior per-issue forecasts, unchanged. This experiment changes uncertainty bands, not the point forecasting algorithms.
calibration: All wrappers use strictly matured residuals from prior issued predictions, 28-calendar-day trailing window, minimum 96 outcomes. Before that, use the same saved 2023 absolute-residual initial radius. No future target is filled.
update_frequency: Once per UTC day before issuing that day's intervals
label_delay_boundary: target_epoch + delay strictly less than day-start update time. The 90-minute condition stresses interval feedback ONLY; the inherited point forecasts keep their original 30-minute timing assumption. Neither delay is a measured NOAA publication latency.
activity_scale: sqrt(1 + max(current_wave_proxy,0) / max(saved_2023_ridge_training_mean_of_current_proxy,1e-9)); dimensionless, fixed before scoring
legacy_pooled_28d: Saved 2023 initial radius; otherwise numpy linear empirical 90th percentile of absolute matured residuals. Must reproduce original saved radius at 30-minute delay within 1e-10 relative/absolute tolerance.
activity_scaled_28d: Finite-rank 90th percentile of abs(residual)/scale_at_original_issue, multiplied by current scale. Rank ceil((n+1)*0.9), bounded to available finite sample. Not an exchangeability guarantee.
signed_scaled_28d: Equal-tail 5th/95th finite-rank signed normalized residual bounds, ranks floor((n+1)*0.05) and ceil((n+1)*0.95), bounded to available sample. Bounds shifted by point prediction and truncated at zero.
adaptive_scaled_28d: Same symmetric normalized radius with quantile 1-alpha_state. Each newly matured own interval miss updates alpha_state=clip(alpha_state+0.005*(0.10-miss),0.02,0.25), chronological outcome order, at day boundary. No update from future/unresolved labels. Clipped, delayed, batched ACI-inspired heuristic: original ACI theoretical guarantees are NOT claimed.
evaluation: All original 2025 issue/target pairs with finite original truth and target before 2026-01-01; exactly the same pairs for all methods and both latency conditions. Missing targets remain missing in feedback and scoring.
adverse_slices: high activity known at issue: saved current proxy >= fixed saved 2023 95th-percentile threshold
high realized target: original truth >= same threshold; retrospective outcome slice, not deployable detection
each month with at least 100 evaluated forecasts
paired_uncertainty: Descriptive 95-percent intervals for interval-score improvement over the same point model's legacy wrapper at 30-minute delay; 2000 moving-block bootstrap draws of 7 calendar days and 14-day sensitivity, fixed seed 20260906. Daily sufficient-statistic sums retain empty calendar days. No multiplicity-adjusted discovery or superiority claim.
interpretation: Coverage alone is insufficient: also report width and interval score. All methods, stations and adverse slices retained. No selected wrapper is promoted from this reused record; a fresh registered period and independent review remain required.
delivery: Commit source/tests, execute in GitHub, publish non-latest research prerelease with verified asset digest and original source, mirror the resulting packet to the existing private Google Drive handoff folder, update PR215 and tracker214. No main merge, DNS, VPS or production mutation.
